descriptionChirho: Edomite (אֲדֹמִי), the gentilic adjective/noun referring to a person or people from Edom, the nation descended from Esau. All three clusters represent the same gentilic in different grammatical forms: S80089 (7x) covers the masculine singular with and without the article ('the Edomite', used especially of Doeg the Edomite in 1 Sam 21-22 and Ps 52 title), S80090 (3x) covers masculine and feminine plurals including conjunctive waw ('Edomites', 'Edomite women' as in 1 Kgs 11:1), and S80091 (2x) is masculine plural without article. Multilingual evidence is uniform: English 'Edomite/Edomites', Spanish 'edomita/edomitas', Hindi एदोमी, Arabic الْأَدُومِيُّ/أَدُومِيُّونَ/أَدُومِيَّاتٍ, Korean 에돔-사람/에돔인/에돔-여인들, Swahili Mwedomu/Waedomu. All forms denote the same ethnic identity with only number and gender inflection differing.
